requirement_table.text: Register ID at 0x000 reads 0x20940001.
Register BUILD at 0x004 reads the USR_ACCESSE2 word.
Register SCRATCH at 0x008 reads back the written 32-bit value.
Register SCRATCH at 0x008 reads 0 after reset.
Reads of unmapped addresses return 0.
Writes to unmapped addresses change no register.
h_rdata shows the addressed register within 2 clk cycles of h_re.
h_rdata keeps its value until the next h_re.
Each output equals saturate16((sum h[k]*x[n-k] + 0x4000) >>> 15) bit for bit against the Python model for an impulse.
Each output equals the Python model bit for bit for a step input.
Each output equals the Python model bit for bit for 10000 random samples sent in chunks of 1000 with no CLEAR between them.
The design uses 16 multipliers on DSP slices by exploiting coefficient symmetry.
The datapath accepts one sample per clk_dsp clock.
The datapath clock closes timing at 250 MHz or faster with WNS >= 0.
The input FIFO holds 1024 samples.
IN_PUSH on a full input FIFO is ignored.
The output FIFO holds 1024 samples.
OUT_POP read returns bit 31 = 1 and bits 15:0 = the oldest output and removes it.
OUT_POP read on an empty output FIFO returns 0x00000000.
RUN processes every sample in the input FIFO in order into the output FIFO.
Filter history persists across runs until CLEAR.
CLEAR empties both FIFOs and zeroes filter history, SAT_COUNT and SAMPLES_DONE.
CTRL bits 0 and 1 read back 0 the clock after the write.
STATUS bit 0 is 1 from RUN until the last result is in the output FIFO.
STATUS bits 15:4 hold the input FIFO count.
STATUS bits 31:20 hold the output FIFO count.
SAT_COUNT counts outputs that were clamped since CLEAR.
SAMPLES_DONE counts samples processed since CLEAR.
sfp_tx_disable is 1 at all times.
The design instantiates no GT transceiver channel.
data/jtag_bus.sv is used unchanged.
The build report lists the DSP slice count used.
The build report lists the clock frequency met by the datapath.
The 250 MHz datapath clock is generated from the 25 MHz clock on pin C3 by an MMCM.
